works.body:
Hello! I would love it if you drew my original character, Innocent Euangelos.

He's normally a kind character, yet keeps to himself because of what he was forced to become. When he thinks of those who had harmed the supposedly blessed angel bound to him, an unnatural hatred occurs within him that he doesn't wish to have.
He was truly merged with the soul of a false god, the Lightwarden Innocence, at birth, making it be two people in one body. He believes that he is the only person he can trust, trying to form a bond with him. However, using the power granted by this slowly shortens the time he has left as himself. He will only be a vessel and will no longer be himself at all eventually.

You can put him in any pose and give him any expression.

The other two images in the folder are just meant to be used as possible inspiration.

Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kuAaMtDaf8MisH2YhR7I4fEMRb1dKNpO?usp=sharing

Hello! I hope you are having a great day, deg-san. 

Your art style is amazing and unique.

If possible, I'd like to see Isabeau de Baviere (イザボー・ド・バヴィエール ) from マギアレコード in your art style. She's a mature queen type of character who is kind to her daughters and animals, but cruel and intimidating to enemies. She held a motherly love for her daughters until she witched out. Since France and the king only saw her as a political tool and a decoration, eventually Isabeau planned revenge on the entire country. Since this is Isabeau before witching out, I like to see her expression being healthy, maybe an evil smirk, as if she is looking towards an enemy.

With that information being said, I will leave the rest of the details up to you. 

Thank you for your consideration.

Reference: https://wiki.puella-magi.net/Isabeau

I have included a folder with reference images! Please make him wear whatever you like, but he likes to wear black the most. Please draw him in whatever pose you like too. He has a dragon tattoo on one arm. He paints his fingernails black. It's a little hard to see but he has amber brown eyes. If his mouth is open, he has a tongue piercing. Thank you so much and please take care!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vu-LPB1iZ-dSNK7GlKcRh4DpCO1Qz0p4?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you. I always enjoy your BSD illustrations.
I am always amazed at the range of your expressive ability, from heartwarming four-panel comic strips to serious illustrations.
I especially like the trickster-like Gogol, the lovely and fragile Sigma, the beautiful but charming Tatsuhiko Shibusawa, and the mysterious and fascinating Dostoevsky. I also liked Agatha's graceful paintings that she used to draw.

The genre of the character you would like to request is original, gender is female, age is late 20s, height is 165-170cm, tall and thin.
Her appearance is neutral, with an air of fragility and transparency, but not fragility.
She has a light hair color in the platinum blonde or ash blonde range, and her eyes are a translucent light blue rather than dark blue, giving the impression of being from a snowy European country.
She has a gentle personality and often smiles quietly; she is a beautiful woman who looks like a thorn removed from Agatha of BSD and has combat skills.
She has a similar vibe to BSD's Shibusawa and Dostoevsky, and looks more doll-like and beautiful than pretty enough to make you want to protect her.

Image illustration created by picrew "MY DOLL MAKER
https://picrew.me/image_maker/610761/complete?cd=A20iGPdEuU
Without outerwear
https://picrew.me/image_maker/610761/complete?cd=GwSnFRs07Q
Please change the details according to deg's style.
I'm not very good at assembling the parts, so it's hard to tell, but she wears a corset around her waist, and the overall silhouette is as sleek as DeadApple's fortifications.

Hair color image
https://arine.jp/articles/22628
The length of the hair is about waist-length, but it can be changed according to the composition of the illustration.

I have mentioned the name of the BSD character in the image because it is the only genre of BSD that I have seen and know from deg's illustrations, but it is not a character in the image of a copyrighted character.

Well then, please do so.

Hi!
I find your art style VERY suitable for this character and was wondering if you could draw a this piece for me.

Please draw my character コハル with スクアーロ from 家庭教師ヒットマンREBORN!
Their height difference is about 3/4 of a head.
Please draw something similar to the pose reference given!
Expressions are up to you, the mood overall should be cheerful and exciting.

Hi, I was wondering if it is possible to have my doll painted?
I'm sorry if dolls are not your thing. If you do, please don't look at the URL and discard it (for the doll photo).

If possible, I would like to have an illustration for iPhone wallpaper (vertical).
Size: iPhone 12, 2532 x 1170, 19.5 : 9

The composition and clothes can be left up to you (from the photo or arranged, originals are welcome), and I would be happy to have her wear lots of accessories such as earrings and necklaces. Thank you very much for your cooperation.

https://imgur.com/a/BdP8SHY

Hi! I would like to ask for a drawing of my OC, an evil witch. Please draw her in whatever pose you like best! 

Her personality is arrogant and very prideful, but also very tired and annoyed with most people. She has a mature, dangerous and seductive aura.

Thank you for your time!

https://imgur.com/a/yOzW3jg

Hello!  I really like your expressive art! I was wondering if you would draw one of my D&D characters. She is a knight that can call upon the echos of other timelines to help in battle. She is a half elf, but tries to hide her pointed ears with her head dress. Feel free to draw her with or without her headgear!

https://toyhou.se/2192723.sehanine

Hello! I would really love it if you drew my character. 

His name is Valia Cassius. He is 190 cm tall without his heels on and 28 years old. He's a very charismatic, dramatic, and eccentric person with a prominent sadistic streak. Aside from violence, he likes games, costumes, theatre, and dancing. His aura is someone that is playful but very dangerous beneath the surface.

In all honesty, I'm a huge Kolya fan and I love the way you portray him! Your art was a big inspiration for certain parts of Valia's personality. The pose is entirely up to you, but I've attached some extra reference photos in the Google Drive folder in case you need some inspiration. Don't feel obligated to include the weapon unless you want to. It's difficult to tell in the photos, but he has a small heart tattoo under his left eye that is the same colour as his hair. 

Thank you so much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1DrpvzP1BKo1CqIH1DWQDpuSaaN4Ecx1I?usp=sharing

Hello! I would love for you to draw my fox girl Revi! 

She's got a bit of a cool and mature personality. I was thinking perhaps a smirking expression/something confident. Perhaps half-body without any sort of special pose. Sort of like this: https://i.imgur.com/PJG8eii.jpg 

I would like her hair down, please. If it becomes relevant her nails are typically painted black, and she has sharp features with very tall ears. 

Colors would be great, but I also love monochromatic work. Whatever you feel most comfortable with! 

Thank you so much for your consideration!

https://imgur.com/a/VplacYt
